cases.description: Sandvik 家族下的工业站内页装配必须统一到标准 skeleton
cases.prompt:
Create an English industrial manufacturing website for LC-CNC (Lingchuang Intelligent), a Shenzhen CNC machine factory specializing in 3C CNC machining centers for Southeast Asia. Use Sandvik as the exact template reference and base. Similar to Sandvik. Inspired by Sandvik. Match the Sandvik desktop industrial template family and visual language. Do not use Siemens or any other template family. Use template-first generation. Generate these pages exactly: Home, 3C Machines, Custom Solutions, Cases, About, Contact, Privacy. Routes must be exactly: /, /3c-machines, /custom-solutions, /cases, /about, /contact, /privacy. Navigation must be exactly: Home | 3C Machines | Custom Solutions | Cases | About | Contact.

Home hero: Precision 3C CNC Machines for Southeast Asia Subtitle: 10-Day Prototype • 15-Day Delivery • 24/7 WhatsApp Support CTAs: Get Quote on WhatsApp | Request Catalog
Primary CTA: Get Quote on WhatsApp
Secondary CTA: Request Catalog
Product cards must feature these four machines:
- 3C Phone-Frame Center
- 3C Laptop-Shell Center
- 3C Camera-Bezel Center
- 3C Keypad Center
Features strip must include:
- Fast Customization → 10-Day Sample
- Short Lead-Time → 15-Day Shipment
- Local Support → WhatsApp + Regional Agent
Cases section must focus on these applications:
- Phone Display Frame Machining
- Laptop Shell Machining
- Camera Bezel Machining
- Phone Keypad Machining
About summary: LC-CNC, Shenzhen since 2013. ISO-certified plant, 30+ R&D engineers, 200+ installed across SEA.
Certification section: ISO 9001 | CE | SGS
Business details:
Company name: LC-CNC
WhatsApp: +86-158-1370-3777
Email: sales@lc-cnc.com
Address: Bao'an, Shenzhen, China
Footer: Products | Support | Privacy
